skills.name: Aura of Steadfastness
skills.text: Chant a litany of steadfastness: while it holds you gain {armourPct}% armour and {resistPct}% to all resistances. It reserves {reserve}% of your max Mana.

variants.name: Grounded
variants.text: Stuns, fear, roots and other control effects on you last {ccCut}% shorter.

skills.name: Hymnal
skills.text: Your auras reserve less of your Mana ({auraReserve} percentage points each). At rank 3 they reach one tile further.

skills.name: Aura of Zeal
skills.text: Chant a litany of zeal: while it holds you attack {speedPct}% faster and deal {dmgPct}% more damage. It reserves {reserve}% of your max Mana.

variants.name: Sanguine
variants.text: You heal for {healPct}% of the damage you deal.

skills.name: Sacred Brand
skills.text: Brand a foe within {range} tiles for {turns} turns: it takes {takenPct}% more damage from every source, and each of your weapon hits on it adds {dmg} Holy Fire damage.

variants.name: Spreading
variants.text: When the branded foe dies, the brand jumps to the nearest foe.

variants.name: Condemn
variants.text: The branded foe is also Vulnerable.

variants.name: Lantern-mark
variants.text: Your attacks against the branded foe gain {critPct}% critical chance.

skills.name: Aura of Cleansing Fire
skills.text: Chant a litany of cleansing fire: while it holds, foes within {radius} tiles take {dot} Holy Fire damage each turn. It reserves {reserve}% of your max Mana.

variants.name: Hallowed
variants.text: The fire deals {unholyPct}% more damage to Unholy foes.

variants.name: Smoke
variants.text: Foes inside the aura are Blinded while they stay in it.

variants.name: Purity
variants.text: Each turn the fire burns {cleanse} harmful effect off you.

skills.name: Choir of the Faithful
skills.text: The effects of your auras are {auraEffectPct}% stronger.

skills.name: Tolling Bell
skills.text: Toll the great bell: foes within {radius} tiles are Stunned for {stunTurns} turn, and Unholy foes within {fearRadius} tiles are Feared for {fearTurns} turns.

variants.name: Death Knell
variants.text: Foes other than bosses below {executePct}% Life die at the sound.

variants.name: Summoning Peal
variants.text: Foes within {pullRadius} tiles are drawn to stand beside you.

variants.name: Clarion
variants.text: Your other cooldowns fall by {cdCut} turns.

skills.name: Twin Litanies
skills.text: You may hold a second aura at the same time, at {auraSecondPct}% of its effect.

strings.tree.desc: Chant litanies that harden you and burn the wicked around you.
strings.buff.steadfastness.name: Aura of Steadfastness
strings.buff.steadfastness.desc: Your litany steadies body and soul against harm: you have {pct}% more armour.
strings.buff.steadfastness.resist: Every resistance you have is raised by {pct}%.
strings.buff.zeal.name: Aura of Zeal
strings.buff.zeal.desc: Your litany quickens your arm and sharpens your blows: you deal {pct}% more damage.
strings.buff.cleansing_fire.name: Aura of Cleansing Fire
strings.buff.cleansing_fire.desc: Your litany kindles a holy fire that scorches every foe within {radius} tiles of you.
strings.buff.sacred_brand.name: Sacred Brand
strings.buff.sacred_brand.desc: A burning sign marks this creature for judgement. It takes {pct}% more damage, and holy fire answers every blow against it. It fades in {turns} turns.
strings.buff.aura.reserve: The litany holds back {reserve}% of your Mana while it lasts.
strings.buff.aura.second: As your second litany it works at {pct}% of its strength.
strings.log.death_knell: The bell tolls, and the weak fall.
strings.log.brand_spreads: The sacred brand leaps to a new bearer.
